title: Music Producer
description:
Who we are

Melotech is revolutionizing media and entertainment. We create art through technology for humans to enjoy. In just 24 months, our work has been heard, watched and loved for over 3 billion minutes worldwide.

Founded by entrepreneur and investor Soheil Mirpour, we are backed by top VCs Cherry Ventures, Speedinvest and GFC, alongside world-class angels from firms such as Spotify, Blackstone and KKR.

What you will do

Our catalogue grows every week, and every track passes through one pair of hands before it is released. As Music Producer, you own that final mile: you combine every input into one finished record, and you are responsible for holding the quality bar high. We will walk you through exactly what we are building as you go through the process. On a typical day, your tasks may include:

  • Combining and finishing: taking instrumentals and vocals, aligning, tuning and editing the vocal, balancing the mix and delivering a release-ready track

  • Mastering: mastering every track to a consistent loudness, tone and format standard for streaming platforms, with clean metadata and stems archived

  • Quality review: listening to every song before it goes live, accepting it or sending it back with precise notes, and keeping a written standard everyone delivers to

  • Production organisation: running the pipeline from brief to final master, and knowing at any moment what is where, who owes what and what ships this week

  • Tooling: using stem separation, tuning, mastering and AI audio tools wherever they make the work faster and more consistent

Who you are

We're looking for a producer with an engineer's ear, or a mixing and mastering engineer who thinks like a producer. You have finished a high volume of tracks for release, and you hear what is wrong with a delivery in the first thirty seconds.

Typically, your profile will look like this:

  • Experience: 3 or more years producing, mixing or mastering music that was commercially released, ideally at volume (labels, distributors, production houses, library music) rather than one album a year

  • Mixing and mastering: you master to streaming loudness standards, you know your chain and your DAW (Ableton, Logic, Pro Tools or similar) inside out, and you can show released tracks you finished

  • Vocal production: you align, tune, edit and sit a vocal into an instrumental it was not recorded with, and the result sounds like one record

  • Quality control: you have evaluated other people's work against a standard, given structured feedback that made the next delivery better, and said no when it mattered

  • Organisation: you have run a production pipeline with many tracks in flight, hard deadlines and remote freelancers, and nothing got lost

  • Genre range: you are comfortable across country, soul, reggae and metal, and you adapt your chain to the genre instead of forcing one sound on everything

  • Pace: you thrive in a fast-paced and performance-oriented environment

  • A big plus: you have used AI music generation or stem separation tools in a real release workflow, and you follow what is happening in AI music closely

What makes this exciting

Every track we release passes through you. You set the sound and the standard for a catalogue that reaches millions of listeners, and you shape how a new kind of music production runs at scale. You're not a cog in the machine but the captain of your own ship, rewarded for performance and respected for leadership. Flat hierarchies mean that your voice matters, your ideas get implemented, and your impact is immediate.

We pay competitive salaries and make you an owner of the business with equity. We work remotely to give you complete freedom over your life, while meeting regularly around the world for global offsites where we strategize, bond, and push boundaries together.

What the process will look like

We hire on a rolling basis. Earliest starting date is always ASAP.

Once you begin our process, you can progress from start to offer within a week, depending on how quickly you can move through each stage:

  1. Initial interview: 30-minute introductory call, getting to know you

  2. Practical test: combine and master one track from stems we send you, plus a short written review of two deliveries

  3. Founder interview: 90-minute interview with our CEO, going deep on all topics

  4. Offer, contract signing and onboarding

Note: As we are still in stealth, you will learn more about Melotech as you progress through the stages. By the end of the Founder interview, you will have a full grasp of our business and the details of your role.

title: Associate Product Owner
description:
TL;DR

Full-time. Berlin-based. No remote option available for this role. You sit with the PM.

Join GlassDollar as an Associate Product Owner and own the space between a good idea and a shipped feature.
Someone has to decide what "done" means, write it down clearly enough that an engineer can start on Monday, and stay close enough to the build that the scope does not quietly grow on the way. That is the job. You own it end to end: specs, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and a backlog that keeps everyone honest about what is actually shipping. Nobody hands you a ticket queue you did not write yourself.

The problem you'll be solvingA corporation with 100,000 employees has thousands of expensive operational problems, and somewhere out there a startup has already solved most of them. Getting those two facts to meet is slow, political, and mostly attempted in spreadsheets that die in someone's downloads folder.
GlassDollar OS is the venture clienting platform that makes it repeatable: sourcing the startups, matching them to real problems, running the pilots, and rolling out what works across the whole organisation. Enterprise customers run real innovation budgets through it. What you scope this month decides what they can do next quarter.


What we're looking for

You have personally written the tickets.
3+ years in a product company, where scoping and ticket-writing were actually your job rather than something you handed off.
You are technical enough to argue with engineers.
AI models, API contracts, estimates, sequencing. You push back with reasons, and you change your mind when the reasons coming back are better.
You can write.
A spec is a piece of writing. We will ask for a sample where the reasoning is visible, polish second.
You write specs worth acting on.
The valuable ones pull three threads together: where the product is going, what clients are actually telling us, and the knowledge already sitting in the team. You gather all three before you write, so what lands on the board is specific enough to build and pointed enough to matter.
You know what looks good.
You have a great sense of design and what feels good for users. We will ask you to build a prototype with AI and illustrate the specs visually.
You have worked somewhere small enough that there was nowhere to hide.
No layers between you and the consequences of a bad spec.
You want to be coached hard.
Direct feedback, weekly, on your actual work. You will scope alongside the product lead until you are doing it alone, and the goal is that this happens fast.
You are fluent with AI tooling, day to day.
We want to see the workflow, not hear it described.
You want the scope to grow.
The people who do best here end up owning areas outright: the major initiatives, the roadmap arguments, and the questions everyone else brings their doubts to. That is earned, and it is genuinely available.


What you'll do

Your job: turn validated opportunities into work an engineer can start on Monday.

  • Turning opportunities into scoped, sequenced, estimable work: specs, acceptance criteria, edge cases, dependencies
  • Running the backlog: grooming, prioritisation input, keeping the board honest about what is in flight, blocked, or quietly drifting
  • Being the interface between customer signal (support threads, CS conversations, call notes) and the engineering queue
  • Coordinating releases and checking that what shipped matches what was scoped
  • Presenting product decisions to varied stakeholder groups, from engineers to enterprise clients

What you'll be scoping over your first year:
  • Deep integrations into our customers' organisations. Their systems, their data, their identity stack. This is the work that turns GlassDollar from a tool people visit into infrastructure they run on.
  • Public REST APIs and MCP servers, so our customers' engineers and their AI agents can build on top of us.
  • AI embedded across the product, inside the surfaces people already work in.
  • Workflow automation inside the platform, so the work that used to take six meetings and a shared spreadsheet runs itself.
You will need to understand each of these well enough to write the spec and defend it in the room.
This is a doing role rather than a people-management one. Mid-to-senior individual contributor.


Requirements

  • 3+ years in a product company, where you personally wrote the tickets
  • Technical enough to understand a data model, an API contract, and estimation
  • Demonstrable writing ability, be ready to share a spec, PRD or decision doc
Nice to have:
  • B2B enterprise SaaS background
  • Familiarity with venture clienting, corporate innovation, or startup-scouting workflows
  • Notion fluency

Don't check every box? Apply anyway. We care more about the questions you ask about a brief than the answer you land on.


How we hire

Straightforward. Respectful of your time. No mystery steps.

  1. Intro call: a quick chat to see if there's a match
  2. Interview with the PM, including a brief introduction to the work sample: a spec, PRD, or decision doc where your reasoning is visible, plus examples of problems you've framed
  3. Interview
  4. Offer: if it clicks, we don't wait around

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
About CHAPTERS Group

CHAPTERS Group AG is a Hamburg-based holding company investing in 55+ mission-critical software companies across the DACH region, France, and the Czech Republic. Our companies deliver the digital solutions that keep the public sector and core industries running. What they do matters in daily life.

AI has rapidly disrupted the software industry, and we aim to lead that transformation across our portfolio. Central to this is the AI Core team: we build and operate a shared enterprise AI Hub used by companies across the group, and drive adoption through a network of AI Champions. Each portfolio company has one designated power user who leads AI enablement locally, runs training, and scales usage within their organisation.

Tasks

The Role

You are a core member of the AI Core team, owning the infrastructure that powers AI adoption across 55+ portfolio companies. Your focus is the AI Hub platform (Open WebUI): you keep it running, deploy new instances, build and validate integrations at HQ level, and make sure every company in the group gets a stable, well-configured environment.

We build the AI Hub as a product and support to ship it in every company. Each company owns their HUB and administers it (L1 Support). You are part of the central team that drives features and changes that are of high value for all hubs in the portfolio.

In addition, you are part of the team that serves as the center of expertise (L2 Support) and give guidance and hands-on support when the first level teams need you.

What You Will Work On

  • Platform engineering: new integrations, container images, infrastructure-as-code, deployment tooling and security patches. This is the product that every company runs
  • Release qualification: when the upstream project ships a new version, you assess it (one-way database migrations, breaking changes, patch compatibility), validate it on a canary, and publish a qualified release with notes that an L1 can act on
  • Shared infrastructure: Application Gateway, WAF policies, TLS certificates, Redis, DNS and network peering. This layer is shared across every company and cannot be devolved. A mistake here affects all of them
  • Enable the L1 network and be their technical point of contact: write the developer guides, run onboarding and office hours, and build preflight checks and guardrails that make it safe for a platform admin to deploy and operate their own Hub.
  • Integrations Catalog stewardship: versioned artefacts (tools, skills, agents, integrations) each shipped with a user guide for AI Champions and a developer guide for platform admins
  • Fleet observability: reporting and alerting version parity, uptime, cloud spend and deployment status across all companies.
  • Own the eval service: the service itself, the quality of judges and generators, and the methodology platforms use to measure whether their agents do the work
  • Close the loop. Shipping is the beginning. Your designs gather operational signals from the fleet and feed a continuous improvement cycle

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

Required

  • At least 2 years of professional experience in platform engineering, DevOps, SRE, or cloud operations, including ownership of production systems that others depend on
  • Production cloud experience on Azure or AWS
  • Infrastructure as Code in production: Bicep, Terraform, CDK or CloudFormation. We care that you think in IaC.
  • Strong Python skills beyond scripting: you have built and maintained small production services, worked with APIs, and found your way around unfamiliar codebases
  • Comfortable with Linux, Docker, Git and CI/CD as everyday working tools
  • Working knowledge of databases and identity: PostgreSQL in production, and OAuth / SSO / Entra ID concepts
  • AI-native: you use LLMs as tools, understand their operational properties, and have shipped something with them
  • English (fluent): primary working language across the team; German conversational is a plus

Bonus

  • Clear technical writing: Enabling others is a real part of this role and good documentation is part of the work rather than an afterthought
  • Experience building internal platforms or tooling used by other engineering teams
  • Working in multi-tenant or multi-customer cloud environments
  • Contributions to open-source projects, or maintaining a modified version of one in production
  • Practical experience with LLM frameworks, agents, MCP or RAG systems in production
  • French language skills: a share of our portfolio is in France and growing

Benefits

What You'll Get

  • A role that shapes the AI backbone for more than 50 software companies across Europe.
  • Become part of CHAPTERS Group, a German serial acquirer with 10x growth in the past five years and high ambitions for what comes next
  • A small, high-ownership team: decisions get made fast, your work ships to production. You are part of the CTO office with a direct line to the leadership team
  • Daily work with cutting-edge AI technologies.
  • Space to define how AI gets integrated into operational business systems at group scale: early-stage work with lasting impact across 55+ companies
  • Permanent full-time position, remote-first with the option to join the team in the Cologne office
  • A clear path to grow with us: we look for ambitious people who want to build a career, not just take a role. We actively invest in your development: talent reviews, events, conferences, etc.

How to Apply

Send your CV and answer the following questions, no formal cover letter needed:

  • Why do you find it exciting to work with vertical market software companies?
  • Why are you the right person to drive AI in the CHAPTERS Group? What is your “unfair advantage”?

We are looking forward to your application!

description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role


Please note: applications will be open until Thursday 24th September 2026 09.00 CEST.
We will no review any applications before the closing date so everyone has equal chances to be selected. Use this time to submit a high quality application that will showcase your strengths.

 

We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our Growth Intelligence team at Pleo. In this role, you'll design and maintain the integration architecture and data contracts that connect our commercial and GTM data layer (the pipelines linking our CRM, billing, and customer success tooling to a central BigQuery warehouse) and be part of the team as we scale our commercial data foundations to support RevOps, Customer Success, and the AI products built on top of them. If you're excited about untangling complex, multi-system architecture and are passionate about building data foundations the whole business can trust, then this is the opportunity for you!

 

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to the Senior Manager of Growth Intelligence and work closely with the RevOps and the BAT (Business Architecture & Technology) teams to understand what commercial operations needs from data. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to keeping Pleo's commercial and GTM data trustworthy and well-governed. You’ll also partner with Analytics Engineers to ensure pipeline outputs are modelling-ready, and engage upstream with tool owners and engineering teams to push data quality and schema discipline closer to the source.

 

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will:

  • Design, build, and maintain data pipelines between commercial tools (HubSpot, Zuora, Vitally) and our BigQuery data warehouse.

  • Own reverse ETL flows: enrich or define data in the warehouse and push it back into operational tools like HubSpot, keeping definitions consistent across systems.

  • Implement and maintain data contracts with clear ownership, SLAs, and schema agreements between data producers (tool owners, product engineers) and data consumers (analysts, RevOps, AI tooling).

  • Partner with RevOps and the BAT team to understand operational data requirements and translate them into reliable, governed pipelines.

  • Build monitoring and alerting that catches data quality issues before they surface in dashboards, operational reports, or downstream models.

  • Simplify integration architecture by centralising data flows through the warehouse, reducing point-to-point tool integrations and the maintenance burden that comes with them.

  • Work with Analytics Engineers to ensure pipeline outputs are structured and documented for downstream modelling.

  • Engage upstream with tool owners and engineering teams to move data quality and schema discipline closer to the source.

Our commercial data stack connects subscription billing (Zuora), CRM (HubSpot), and customer success tooling (Vitally) to a central BigQuery data warehouse. You can expect to work with the following tech stack: BigQuery, Python, HubSpot, Zuora, and Vitally plus dbt, Fivetran/Census, or Airflow depending on your background.

 

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • Proven experience building and maintaining production data pipelines in a commercial or GTM data environment.

  • Strong understanding of CRM data models, APIs, and field management (HubSpot or comparable experience).

  • Hands-on experience with reverse ETL patterns: pushing warehouse-enriched or warehouse-defined data back into operational tools.

  • Extensive BigQuery experience.

  • Experience implementing data contracts in a production environment.

  • Python proficiency for pipeline development, transformation logic, and tooling.

  • Git-based workflows and CI/CD experience for data engineering code.

 

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You are equally excited by deep technical work as you are by collaborating with business stakeholders.

  • You can comfortably work with a wide variety of data sources and can operate within a complex multi-system environment.

  • You truly shine at solving problems and driving alignment between GTM/commercial stakeholders.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You prefer to work on platform matters that are one step removed from the business.

  • You have never collaborated with senior stakeholders on GTM / commercial analytics work.

  • You need a very defined roadmap and backlog to operate efficiently. You'll need to adapt to rapid changes and be part of the roadmap definition discussions in this role.

 

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Become familiar with our data ecosystem and codebase.

  • Support to drive a HubSpot reimplementation project from the data side.

  • Collaborate with Data Platform & Analytics Engineers as well as GTM teams to improve or commercial analytics efforts.

Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

 

Show me the benefits

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Core skills tests: An async coding exercise through our CoderPad third party platform.

  3. Hiring Manager interview: A 60-minute chat with your Manager to deep dive into your technical experience and impact.

  4. Pleo Challenge: A 75-minute live interview with two colleagues to assess your architecture and problem solving skills.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired a Senior Data Engineer, we received a total of 543 applications but only 15 were selected for an intro call. With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:

  • We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you—not AI—know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background.

  • Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • This role requires experience operating within a SaaS organisation, collaborating closely with GTM teams. It is equally important to demonstrate your technical expertise with production pipelines as it is to demonstrate your understanding and impact across commercial analytics.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

About the job

Cosmic AC is Tether Data's GPU compute and managed inference platform: GPU containers, managed inference endpoints and platform observability, delivered as a self-hosted package on Kubernetes, with a control plane written in JavaScript. The platform is expanding from orchestrating workloads on a managed cluster to owning the full stack on bare-metal GPU infrastructure: a managed Slurm scheduling layer for internal research and model-training teams first, and our own Kubernetes control plane for inference tenancy after that.

The Technical Lead owns the architecture and delivery of that stack and leads the engineering team building it: about twelve engineers across backend, frontend, DevOps, QA and documentation, distributed across Europe and India. The role reports to the Senior Technical Product Manager for Cosmic AC, who owns scope, sequencing and partner commitments; the Technical Lead owns architecture, implementation and delivery plans, line-manages the engineers, and is the primary technical interface to our infrastructure partners.

This is a hands-on infrastructure leadership role with a fixed delivery window in its first six months. It is not a research role, not a pure Kubernetes SRE role, and not a management-only role.

Responsibilities

Architecture. Own the platform architecture end to end: architecture proposals, high-level and low-level designs, driven through review and kept current as the baseline.

Team leadership. Lead and line-manage a distributed team across backend (Node.js), frontend (React), DevOps, QA and documentation: engineering standards, code and design review, release gates, one-to-ones, growth and performance input.

Bare-metal GPU scheduling layer. Design, build and operate a managed Slurm service for research users: controller and accounting, partitions and login nodes, node onboarding and acceptance, driver and CUDA baseline and upgrades, stalled-job and node-health detection, drain and autohealing, storage visibility, identity and isolation.

Kubernetes control plane and GPU enablement. Own cluster bootstrap and lifecycle on partner-provided bare metal, NVIDIA GPU Operator and Network Operator, VM-based GPU isolation (KubeVirt and VFIO), and day-2 operations: upgrades, backup and recovery, node replacement.

Managed inference at scale. Serving architecture, multi-GPU and multi-node parallelism, autoscaling, request routing and endpoint reliability; confidential-compute-capable capacity for sensitive workloads.

Observability and operations. Metrics, logging, alerting and SLOs across control plane, GPU fleet and application tiers; incident response and post-incident review; an on-call model a small team can sustain.

Partners and vendors. Primary technical interface to infrastructure partners and vendors: turning requirements into written specifications and acceptance tests, running escalations to closure, and providing technical input to capacity planning and hardware sourcing.

Internal consumers. Work directly with research, model-training and product teams to translate their workloads into platform requirements, and broker capacity when it is short.

Hiring. Complete the platform team and set the technical bar for the engineers who join it.


Must have

  • Experience. Eight or more years of hands-on engineering, including at least three leading teams that build and operate infrastructure platforms other teams depend on. Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science or engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Slurm at scale, hands on. Has run slurmctld and slurmdbd for real users: partitions, QoS and priority, accounting, prolog and epilog, node health scripting, upgrades with jobs on the system. Ideally has operated an HPC or GPU training cluster for a research population.

  • GPU fleet operation on bare metal. NVIDIA driver and CUDA lifecycle, Fabric Manager and NVSwitch behaviour on SXM systems, DCGM-based health and utilisation, MIG, node burn-in and acceptance.

  • High-performance interconnects. InfiniBand fabric and subnet configuration, RDMA, SR-IOV, and diagnosing multi-node NCCL performance problems.

  • Linux systems depth. Kernel modules and drivers, PCIe passthrough and vfio-pci, cgroups and namespaces, performance tuning for compute-heavy workloads.

  • Production Kubernetes operation, not just deployment: control plane, upgrades, CNI and CSI, operators and custom controllers, multi-tenancy design.

  • HPC storage and data movement. Shared filesystems (VAST, Lustre, NFS), node-local NVMe caching, distributing large model weights and datasets across many nodes.

  • Observability and operations. Prometheus, Grafana and Loki or equivalents, SLOs, incident response and post-incident review.

  • Working fluency in JavaScript and Node.js sufficient to review a control plane, CLI and worker services with authority and to make architecture decisions on them. Not a feature-development requirement.

  • A shipped platform with real users. A multi-tenant IaaS or PaaS, or a research computing service: resource isolation, quotas, usage metering, and user-facing API and CLI surfaces.

  • Leadership that stays in the code. People management across time zones, cross-track review, written architecture decisions with alternatives recorded, and the ability to tell a partner or an executive no with reasons.

  • Excellent written and spoken English. Most partner and leadership work happens in writing.

  • Location. Fully remote, based between UTC and UTC+5:30 so the working day overlaps both Europe and India, where the team and its partners work. Occasional travel to partner sites and team events.

Desirable

  • Slurm operators on Kubernetes (Soperator, Slinky) or Kubernetes-native schedulers (Kueue, Volcano, KAI, Kubeflow Trainer).

  • Modern serving stacks (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM): parallelism strategies, quantisation trade-offs, GPU memory planning.

  • VM and container isolation for multi-tenant GPU compute (KubeVirt, Kata Containers, QEMU and KVM, Firecracker); confidential computing (Intel TDX, AMD SEV-SNP, NVIDIA confidential-compute mode).

  • Cluster API and kubeadm, Cilium, NVSentinel-class autohealing, infrastructure as code and GitOps.

  • Time on the operator side of a GPU cloud, a national or university HPC centre, or an AI lab's platform team.

  • Peer-to-peer or distributed-systems background.

  • Experience with a hardware provider who provisions but does not operate, and turning that relationship into a written contract with acceptance tests.

Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning
 
Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team—from Finance to HR—to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.
 
Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Snowflake, Siemens, and DPD use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario.
 
With a team of 600+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software.
 
At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo—all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

Pigment is seeking an experienced GenAI Engineer with a strong CS background and experience with Large Language Models (LLM) to join our innovative and fast-paced team.
In this role, you will work on cutting-edge NLP projects and play a crucial part in developing and refining our product. If you are passionate about machine learning, have a strong background in natural language processing, and thrive in a collaborative and high-impact environment, we'd love to hear from you!
 
What you will do :
 
- Work on bleeding edge multi-agents features. This includes the improvement of rolled-out features and the conception of new ones.
- Have the opportunity to work on the whole stack. The AI teams have frontend, backend (C# and python), infrastructure and CI skills
- Work on AI features built on top of the Pigment computation engine that provides determinism, auditability and data visualizations
- Work on AI features with an ambitious product vision, that are actively used, have a real world impact and are built to last (high test coverage - you can focus on building the next step, not chasing bugs)
 
🎧Listen to our podcast on Pigment’s GenAI team
📖Read more about our vision: Agentic AI for Data Analysis

  • MS or Ph.D. in Computer Science, or experience writing production-grade code
  • Strong programming skills in Python, and/or C#, Java, nodejs, or equivalent
  • Hands-on experience on prompting large language models. It can be through the usage of vibe coding tools, or having implemented GenAI features
  • Knowledge about the recent developments of agents is a plus
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Product oriented. GenAI challenges are mainly about translating a user need into a simple technical solution
  • If you are passionate about Generative AI and want to work on a cutting-edge business planning platform, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity at Pigment.
  • Bonus: experience working with kubernetes
  • Bonus: experience building agents using langgraph
  • Bonus: experience building and shipping complex products on top of LLMs
  • Bonus: experience building evaluation pipelines

title: Sales Planning & Strategy
description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

🧩 Context of the role

You will be part of the Business Strategy & Operations (BSO) team, whose goal is to

  • Define an ambitious strategy to achieve our business objectives and translate this into an actionable plan

  • Monitor and explain our performance towards our business objectives

  • Enable our Sales and Account Management teams to achieve these business objectives and become the most effective commercial teams in the tech industry (i.e., Sales and AM effectiveness, tools, analytics and training)

Across all these areas we work very closely with the Senior Leadership, the Sales, Account Management and Go-to-Market teams. The scope is Global (France, Belgium, Spain and Canada for the time being).

🎯 Your mission

You will be owning medium to large scale/complexity projects (depending on your skills and experience) on the Business Planning and Strategy area. These would include:

  • Business Strategy

    • Work closely with senior business leaders (Business leads, Insurance Lead, Marketing lead, CFO, CEO, etc.) to define Alan’s business plan

    • Frame business and resource allocation decisions (e.g. where to accelerate/slow down in terms of segments or products, where to deploy sales and marketing resources, how to optimize for short vs. long term, what are is the impact on metrics such as payback, LTV, CAC)

    • Propose adjustments to the plan on a quarterly basis and support Board preparation

  • Sales & Account Manager Planning

    • Translate the plan into actionable sales & Account Management objectives, ensuring their quality, scalability and accuracy

    • Build & improve the infrastructure to track these targets (dashboard, models) hand in hand with the data team

  • Performance monitoring & Steering

    • Lead or support strategic explorations (e.g. new segment, new distribution models) to frame strategic decisions

    • Monitor closely results and execution to gather learnings and adjust where necessary, sharing key learnings with the community and the company on a monthly basis

    • Work on transversal topics that allow us to gain insights & better steer the team performance (competition analysis, implementation & monitoring of pricing strategies, ...)

🧐 Skills we are looking for

We look above all for exceptional people motivated and committed in building one of the most effective Strategy and Planning team.

At least 3 years of experience within either:

  • Business strategy, sales strategy & operations, revenue operations or business finance/ strategic finance departments in a B2B company (preferably)

  • Management consulting, investment banking or private equity

Critical thinking and problem solving skills:

  • Ability to deal effectively with ambiguity, bringing structure to ambiguous areas of opportunity

  • Deep analytical rigour, bringing clarity on complex topics through deep insights

  • Great Excel skills and moderate SQL knowledge. Experience with AI tools and building moderate to complex flows.

  • Ability to handle workload & short turnaround time, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility, when some topics are top priority for the company

Business sense:

  • At ease with B2B operational and financial metrics

  • Passion for getting close to the business and Sales/Marketing teams and understanding the operational details of their work, not just the strategic ones

Communication and presence:

  • Ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership and align multiple stakeholders in a collaborative way

  • Ability to build successful relationships with a broad range of stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Product and Finance and be seen as a trusted contributor/advisor

  • Ability to work well under pressure, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility

  • Great written and oral structure and communication

  • Fluency in English (French is a strong plus)

  • Being based in (or willing to relocate to) the Paris area

Nice to have

  • Experience with BI and visualization tools (Metabase, Tableau) and Salesforce

  • Experience in the SaaS/Tech sectors

  • Exposure to large sales teams (100+)

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C1-D level range.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - ****it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

title: People & Admin Ops.
description:
🩺 Why Prévenir

Prévenir is a new Occupational Health and Prevention Service (SPSTI) in the Île-de-France region.

Our ambition is to rethink occupational health in order to improve its impact on employees’ lives and the experience of healthcare professionals, leveraging Alan’s technology.

Our first medical centre has opened at 117 Quai de Valmy, 75010 Paris, and this is just the beginning!

👉 To learn more about what day-to-day life is like at Prévenir, click here.

⭐ The role, concretely

Are you excited about building, structuring and scaling HR operations in a company that's just getting started? You will join Prévenir at a very early stage and help build the foundations of our People and administrative operations as the company scales. This role is particularly suited to someone who has already experienced a fast-growth environment, whether in a start-up, scale-up or during a 0-to-100 journey.

We're in the early chapters: this isn't about running existing processes — it's about creating them from scratch so they hold up at much larger scale. The role brings a product mindset to People operations, where every key moment of the employee experience is carefully designed, with a constant focus on simplicity and automation. You'll work closely with Lucie, who makes the final calls depending on topic complexity and supports you as you grow into autonomy.

Your time is split between:

  • Employee journey: onboarding, probation-period tracking, setting up and running performance reviews, feedback processes, and monitoring team engagement.

  • Documentation & operational efficiency: writing clear, user-centric documentation, spotting friction, simplifying or automating recurring processes. You leverage AI to multiply the impact of your work.

  • People admin: leave and absence management, payroll back-and-forth, contracting and employee administrative follow-up, onboarding formalities and affiliations (health/provident insurance, occupational health), GDPR compliance.

  • Operational finance: expense reports, preparing and sending accounting documents to Impulsa, preparing routine filings (including VAT).

Over time, this person will take ownership of payroll management in coordination with our accounting partner, with training and support.

👤 The profile we're looking for

Essential:

  • At least 5-6 years of experience in People Ops, very hands-on, and comfortable with admin topics (e.g., managing the relationship with an accounting firm)

  • Previous experience in a fast-scaling company, start-up or scale-up, ideally having helped build or scale People processes during a period of significant growth.

  • Business curiosity: genuinely interested in what's happening on the business side, and able to connect your work to where the company is heading

  • Versatility across People and Corporate/Admin topics, with a strong People focus

  • Rigour and rock-solid attention to detail

  • Autonomy: you don't wait to be told there's a problem — you spot it, bring a solution, and know when to loop someone in on the tricky ones

  • Demonstrated interest in automating and improving recurring processes, and genuine enthusiasm for AI

  • Comfort interacting with a wide range of stakeholders, including senior profiles when needed

  • Fluent English (written and spoken) to interact with the Alan team

  • Based in Paris or the Île-de-France region, with the ability to work onsite regularly, ideally three days per week or more.

Ideally:

  • Experience in MedTech or in a start-up / scale-up

  • Sensitivity to the medical world (professional or personal)

  • Note: a 100% Occupational Health background may not be the right cultural fit, but worth testing

🙏 What we offer

  • Location: 117 Quai de Valmy, Paris 10th, in a brand-new centre designed to support high-quality practice

  • Base salary: between €53,000 and €61,000 gross per year, depending on experience and level

  • Profit-sharing scheme: 10%, in line with Prévenir’s framework

  • Benefits: daily transport costs covered, company restaurant, RTT days and regular team events

description:
LA MAISON JACQUEMUS

 

Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.

 

Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière).

 

Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street).

 

VOTRE RÔLE

Au sein du pôle Développement Maroquinerie, le/la Chef(fe) de produit est garant(e), du développement des produits et du suivi des collections. En lien direct avec la Responsable Développement Maroquinerie, il/elle intervient de manière autonome sur l'ensemble de son périmètre, en étroite collaboration avec les équipes, Création Produit, Merchandising et Production.

 

VOS MISSIONS  

  • Travail en autonomie sur les offres maroquinerie homme, petite maroquinerie, ceintures et projets VIP
  • Accompagnement des fabricants dans le développement des produits, sur la base du brief du studio et du brief merchandising, déplacements sur site à prévoir
  • Gestion du parc de fabricants en collaboration avec l’équipe production (identification des forces et faiblesses, contretype)
  • Propositions d’alternatives techniques auprès du studio et des fabricants, pour anticiper les problématiques industrialisation et costing dans le respect de l’intention créative
  • Pilotage du développement des prototypes et des échantillons dans le respect des délais, de la marge et du niveau de qualité
  • Visibilité prix tout au long de la collection et négociations dans le respect des objectifs de marge
  • En charge du référencements produits et garant de l’exactitude des nomenclatures produits
  • Mise à jour des plans de collection et outils de suivi de collections
  • Support argumentaires spécificités produits pour l’équipe merchandising
  • Gestion planning shooting packshot et conformité produit en lien avec l’équipe image
  • Participation aux organisations défilé (pointage collection, mises en place produit pour editing styling et fitting, packing collection)
  • Préparation et transmission des dossiers techniques aux équipes industrialisation et production.
  • Validations facture et suivi rigoureux des coûts engagés
  • Participation à l’amélioration en continue des process

 

VOTRE PROFIL

  • Bac +3 à Bac +5 (commerce, mode ou équivalent), avec 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en développement produit maroquinerie et/ou petite maroquinerie, idéalement dans l'univers du luxe ou de la mode

 

  • Bonne connaissance du marché et de ses acteurs

 

  • Expérience en gestion fabricants, développement produits et analyse de dossiers techniques

 

  • Maîtrise d'Excel et des outils bureautiques ; connaissance d'un ERP/PLM fortement appréciée

 

  • Anglais professionnel indispensable, italien fortement apprécié

 

  • Forte sensibilité produit alliée à une organisation rigoureuse et un bon sens des priorités

 

  • Aisance relationnelle, esprit d'équipe, proactivité, flexibilité et sens des responsabilités

description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation.


As part of this initiative, we are developing a lunar lander capable of precision landing and reusable operations. To support this effort, we are establishing a dedicated remote test site in the United Arab Emirates to perform hot-fire propulsion testing and hopper flight demonstrations.

We want you as a talented AIT MGSE Engineer to help us in our mission by designing and delivering the MGSEs needed for the preparation and testing of our Lunar Lander.

Key Responsibilities

In your capacity as AIT MGSE Engineer, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day duties will include:

  • Work closely with Engineering and AIT colleagues to understand and refine the requirements/timelines for the different MGSEs that we will need for various assembly or testing activities.

  • Conceptualise, design (CAD including manufacturing drawings), procure and commission the MGSEs.

  • Confirm with mechanical analysis/hand calculations/proof tests that the design is compatible with the external loads.

  • Discuss with suppliers the MGSE designs for ease of manufacturing and with the most adequate processes.

  • Follow up the manufacturing/procurement with the suppliers (with the support of our supply chain team) and answer any technical questions/concerns ensuring timely delivery of all items.

  • Provide necessary instructions and support the assembly / commissioning / implementation of these MGSEs.

What we would love to see from you

In the role of AIT MGSE Engineer ideally, you will have the following:

  • Mechanical / Aerospace engineering degree or similar with focus on machine / structural design.

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in CAD design + drafting (using Siemens NX or similar) and FE analysis (using Hypermesh or similar).

  • Good understanding of machine design and different manufacturing processes (e.g. machining, welding, etc), design for manufacturing and GD&T.

  • Familiarity with standard margin calculation methodologies for various applications like beam design, bolted joints, welds, etc.

  • Experience with planning/execution of mechanical tests in-house would be a plus.

  • Good at documentation including design descriptions, assembly instructions, test reports, etc.

  • Creative with innovative ideas and technical problem solving/troubleshooting skills.

  • Basic hands-on experience with mechanical assembly and simple machining tools like drilling machine.

  • Previous experience in space AIT and MGSE design would be highly appreciated.

  • Good English communication skills (French would be a plus).

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?

As a Customer Success Manager at Camunda, you’ll be the strategic partner to a portfolio of enterprise customers, helping them turn complex process orchestration and automation goals into real, measurable outcomes.   •  Own a portfolio of enterprise customers and act as their primary strategic partner from onboarding through renewal—aligning on goals, success measures, and an adoption roadmap that delivers real business value.

  • Relationship & stakeholder management: Proven ability to build trust with senior and operational stakeholders, navigate complex organizations, and lead candid, outcome-focused conversations.

  • Commercial awareness & forecasting: Experience supporting or owning renewals and expansion in a recurring revenue model, including comfort with forecasting, pipeline hygiene, and risk/opportunity assessment.

  • Data-informed decision-making: Ability to interpret customer data (adoption, health signals, value metrics) and turn it into clear insights, priorities, and next steps for both customers and internal teams.

  • Communication & facilitation: Strong written and verbal communication skills, including leading customer meetings, presenting recommendations, and aligning cross-functional collaborators in a remote-first environment.

  • Experience working closely with technical counterparts (e.g., Solution Architects, TAMs, Engineering, or Product) to drive adoption and resolve complex issues.

title: Technical Sourcer
description:
Meet Arago and the Aragonians

Arago’s mission is to re-engineer the foundations of computing from first principles.

The explosive growth of AI is pushing the industry to rethink how processors are built. Arago is meeting that challenge with a proprietary technology that fuses optical and CMOS technologies to deliver an order-of-magnitude increase in performance.

Arago is the fastest, and currently the only, company to have built such a processor. It's backed by leading deep-tech investors and some of the most respected figures in semiconductors and computing, including the CEO of Arm, the founder of macOS who worked directly with Steve Jobs at Apple, an Nvidia Fellow, the Head of Optics at Google, and many other industry leaders.

Our work is guided by three clear values: do great things, move with high velocity, and operate as one unit. We work in a demanding environment where constant learning, ownership, and execution are expected, and where exceptional people have the opportunity to do their life’s work.

 

What you’ll do

As Technical Sourcer at Arago, you will own the search for some of the most sought-after engineers in the world. We build hardware that has never existed before, and finding the people who can build it requires going far beyond standard recruiting channels.

You will own the full sourcing motion: mapping talent pools, building precise searches, crafting outreach that resonates with passive candidates, and building long-term relationships with high-priority profiles. Working directly with hiring managers and founders, you will develop a deep understanding of each role and the technical landscape around it, then go find the right people, wherever they are.

Responsibilities

  • Build highly targeted searches for Arago's most critical roles, ASIC architects, packaging engineers, mixed-signal verification, SW systems leads

  • Craft outreach that engages passive candidates and builds long-term relationships with high-priority targets

  • Develop creative sourcing strategies: GitHub, research communities, referral networks, X-Ray etc.

  • Partner closely with hiring managers to build customized sourcing strategies

  • Own candidate tracking, pipeline metrics, and funnel data with a structured approach

  • Language: English at a proficient level.

We're Looking For

  • Proven sourcing experience in deep tech, semiconductors, or AI hardware, not just software

  • X-Ray search skills and comfort sourcing across GitHub, LinkedIn, and non-traditional channels

  • Demonstrated success sourcing passive senior technical talent

  • Ability to run multiple complex searches in parallel without dropping quality

  • Genuine curiosity about the technology, you need to understand what you're sourcing for

  • A long-game mindset: relationship building over transactional outreach

Nice to Have

  • Sourcing experience in technical domains

  • Proven track record of filling hard-to-find roles

  • Experience writing outreach that actually gets replies

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with multiple open roles simultaneously

Pay and benefits

  • Competitive cash compensation, with final package based on location, experience, and the pay of team members in similar positions.

  • Meaningful stock option plan offered (included in the majority of full time offers).

  • Healthcare coverage (including family-friendly options), pension contributions, professional development support, and 25 days of PTO, in addition to public holidays.

  • Ownership of a key technical domain, with significant vertical and/or horizontal growth opportunities, based on performance and individual drive.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of AI at Arago.

title: Senior Account Executive
description:
About Gladia

Gladia builds the audio AI infrastructure behind the new generation of voice products. Our mission is to give every voice platform true conversational intelligence — the audio infrastructure that understands every conversation, turning voice into the world's most valuable data layer.

Our API turns real-world conversational audio into accurate, structured, real-time output — powered by our proprietary Solaria ASR, across 100+ languages, with industry-leading latency.

Hundreds of companies build their voice products on Gladia — from meeting assistants and voice agents to sales-enablement and contact-center platforms. We started in Paris, our growth is developer-led and heavily US-driven (and we're going after the US market hard).

Headquartered in vibrant tech hubs like Paris and New York City, Gladia has been by OVH Groupe — Europe's leading cloud provider — and now operates as a fully autonomous brand and company within the Group.

We're guided by four values:

  • Honest — Say the real thing, kindly.

  • Smart — Work smart, ship fast.

  • Builders — Own your scope, build to last.

  • Caring — Support people, take pride in the craft.

As a Senior AE, you'll uncover the challenges organisations ( voice agents, meeting assistants, contact-center platforms) face when they build and run Speech AI at scale and land the right Gladia solution for them. You'll sell a technical, usage or contract based API product to engineering and business stakeholders. Based in Paris. Reporting to Head of Sales.

The role

  • Run a rigorous, repeatable sales process across a range of company types and buyer profiles — from developer-led teams to enterprise buying committees.

  • Own the relationship map for your territory: existing accounts and the aspirational logos you want to win.

  • Build a deep understanding of each customer's business and the technical problem they're solving.

  • Negotiate pricing and terms by selling value and ROI, not discounts.

  • Expand reach and depth across your territory — grow existing accounts while landing new logos.

  • Navigate complex, technical deals with resourcefulness, and know intuitively what it takes to get to close.

  • Work alongside Forward Deployed Engineers in complex Sales cycles and Gladia evaluations

  • Identify the real business drivers behind every opportunity, and qualify hard.

  • Keep forecasting accurate and consistent — your pipeline is always clean.

Who you are

  • 5+ years of closing experience in B2B, ideally selling a technical or API/SaaS product.

  • Consistent track record of meeting or beating direct sales targets

  • Comfortable managing deal sizes of 50K to 150K USD

  • You build your own pipeline — you can show the method, not just the results.

  • Experience selling to engineers and IT decision-makers.

  • Strong knowledge of sales methodologies (MEDDICC, BANT, or similar).

  • Experience winning new logos in an innovative tech environment (SaaS, API, dev tools, IT infrastructure or similar).

  • Collaborative problem-solver, with high standards, proactivity and genuine curiosity.

  • Fluent in English; French a plus.

What Gladia offers

  • The compensation offered is based on seniority and experience, and would typically range from 100K to 140K OTE

title: Chargé.e d'Administration RH (H/F)
description:
À propos d'ILLUIN Technology

ILLUIN Technology est le leader français de l'IA Générative souveraine et de confiance. Nous développons des modèles de langage (LLM) propriétaires et une plateforme technologique de pointe pour permettre aux entreprises et aux organisations de déployer l'IA générative en toute sécurité, en gardant la maîtrise de leurs données.

Adossé au fond privé Seven2, Illuin est entré dans une phase d’investissement et de forte croissance depuis le début de l’année. Dans ce contexte d’accélération, le Groupe recrute un/une Chargé(e) d’Administration RH afin de sécuriser et de professionnaliser l’ensemble des processus administratifs liés au cycle de paie et à l’expérience interne des Illuiners.

Votre Mission

Rattaché(e) directement à la Direction Administratif et Financier, en lien étroit avec les équipes opérationnelles, vous êtes le/la garant(e) du contrôle interne de la paie et de la fiabilité des données sociales. La paie est externalisée auprès d’un prestataire : votre rôle n’est pas de la produire mais d’en assurer la préparation, le contrôle et la coordination de bout en bout.

Vous évoluerez dans un environnement dynamique et agile, dans un contexte de structuration où vous devrez faire preuve de rigueur, de polyvalence et être force de proposition afin de contribuer à l’avancement d’un vaste panel de missions tels que :

  • Pilotage et contrôle de la paie externalisée

    • Collecte, consolidation et transmission des éléments variables de paie au prestataire (entrées/sorties, absences, variables, primes, notes de frais impactant la paie) selon un calendrier de paie maîtrisé ;

    • Contrôle de la saisie des temps par les salariés (suivi des congés etc) ;

    • Collecte des déclarations sociales produites par le prestataire (DSN, charges sociales, organismes de prévoyance et de mutuelle) et suivi des éventuelles anomalies jusqu’à résolution ;

    • Rapprochement de la paie avec la comptabilité en lien avec le CFO et l’expert comptable (écritures de paie, provisions congés payés, comptes de tiers sociaux).

  • Administration du personnel et cycle de vie collaborateur

    • Gestion administrative des entrées : DPAE, rédaction des contrats et avenants, affiliations mutuelle et prévoyance, visites médicales, création des dossiers collaborateurs ;

    • Suivi des évolutions en cours de vie (avenants, mobilités, changements de temps de travail) et des sorties (documents de fin de contrat, coordination avec la paie et le management) ;

    • Suivi des absences, congés, arrêts de travail, IJSS et dossiers de prévoyance ;

    • Gestion des dispositifs collectifs et avantages (titres-restaurant, mutuelle, mobilité durable, remboursements transport) ;

    • Tenue et fiabilisation des obligations administratives : registre unique du personnel, affichages, archivage et conformité RGPD des données sociales.

  • Coordination des prestataires et interlocuteurs externes

    • Interlocuteur(trice) de référence du cabinet de paie : animation du rythme de collaboration, cadrage des livrables, respect des échéances et arbitrage des points bloquants ;

    • Point de contact avec les organismes externes (URSSAF, organismes de retraite et de prévoyance, médecine du travail, OPCO, mutuelle) en lien avec le prestataire et le CFO;

  • Data & Process Owner RH

    • Élaboration et documentation de l’ensemble des processus administratifs RH et de l’outillage associé (SIRH), dans un contexte de croissance et avec la perspective d’intégration de nouvelles entités ;

    • Garantie de la qualité et de la cohérence de la donnée sociale entre le SIRH, la paie et les outils Finance.

  • Conformité sociale et missions ponctuelles

    • Veille sur la réglementation sociale et l’application de la convention collective, avec appui de conseils externes sur les sujets complexes ;

    • Contribution aux obligations et échéances annuelles (index égalité professionnelle, déclarations obligatoires, préparation des audits) ;

    • Participation aux projets de structuration de la fonction People : déploiement ou évolution du SIRH, automatisation des processus, préparation des instances représentatives du personnel.

Profil Recherché

Il s’agit d’un poste évolutif, à la fois du fait de la croissance et de l’ambition du Groupe mais aussi de la variété des chantiers rencontrés laissant ainsi la place à l’expression des appétences de chacun.

  • Formation en Ressources Humaines, gestion de la paie ou droit social (Licence/Master, titre professionnel gestionnaire de paie)

  • Une expérience confirmée en administration du personnel et en gestion ou contrôle de la paie, en entreprise ou en cabinet

  • Bonne connaissance des mécanismes de paie et du cadre légal et conventionnel français ; une connaissance de la convention Syntec est un plus

  • Notions et curiosité appréciées sur les outils SIRH, l’automatisation des processus et l'A appliquée aux fonctions support

Nous recherchons un profil autonome et force de proposition faisant preuve d’une grande rigueur et d’un sens aigu de la confidentialité. Vous devrez faire preuve de curiosité, de polyvalence et d’une capacité d’adaptation pour évoluer sur plusieurs sujets de front demandant un regard critique, ainsi que d’un vrai sens du service auprès des collaborateurs.

Ce que propose le poste

  • Un rôle central et à forte visibilité, au contact de l’ensemble des collaborateurs et en lien direct avec la Direction,

  • Un périmètre complet, de la paie à l’administration du personnel,

  • La possibilité de construire son propre périmètre et sa fonction de zéro, en proposant les outils et les processus qui structureront la fonction People.

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

Afin d’accompagner notre croissance et répondre à nos enjeux 2026, nous ouvrons un nouveau poste au sein de l’équipe Sales en charge de la relation avec les clients SMEs des cabinets comptables partenaires de Pennylane.

Tu auras un rôle central en étant le point de contact privilégié des cabinets comptables souhaitant déployer Pennylane chez leurs clients

En effet, depuis 1 an, nous accélérons fortement dans l’acquisition de nouveaux cabinets comptables. L’outil Pennylane prenant tout son sens lorsque les Experts Comptables et leurs clients travaillent ensemble dessus, c’est dans leur intérêt d’équiper au maximum leurs clients.

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

  • En échangeant avec les cabinets comptables partenaires pour identifier les SMEs de leurs portefeuilles les plus à même de pouvoir s’équiper de Pennylane.

  • En mettant en place des actions commerciales terrains (évènements physiques, webinaires, journée portes ouvertes) afin de faire connaître Pennylane auprès des SMEs de nos cabinets comptables partenaires.

  • En gérant de l’ensemble du cycle de vente de Pennylane sur ces SMEs (Qualification, Démo, Closing).

Tu travailleras main dans la main avec:

  • Les Account Executives Cabinets Comptables : ils sont en charge de vendre Pennylane à un maximum de cabinets comptables.

  • Les Account Managers : ils gèrent la relation commerciale avec le cabinet comptable et la coordination des projets de monétisation des SMEs avec nos cabinets comptables partenaires.

 

A quoi ressembleront tes débuts chez nous?

 

3 premiers mois :

  • Tu apprends à connaître Pennylane, sa vision, ses équipes afin de t'y sentir pleinement intégré

  • Tu intègres la sales academy afin de connaître parfaitement le rôle de chacun et de saisir le fonctionnement de l'équipe sales au global

  • Tu es formé par ton manager afin de prendre tes marques au sein de l'équipe

  • Tu montes en compétences sur l’outil

  • Tu prends en main tes prospects, accompagné par ton manger

  • Tu deviens autonome sur des ventes simples

4 à 8 mois

  • Tu gères en autonomie tes premières ventes complexes

  • Tu traites des leads de plus en plus complexes et stratégiques pour l'entreprise

  • Tu participes aux améliorations des process au sein de l'équipe et partage tes bonnes pratiques

  • Tu collabores avec les autres équipes de Pennylane (customer care, produit, sales...) afin de transmettre tes retours clients et participer à l'amélioration continue de notre plateforme

Et ensuite... :

  • Tu deviens un(e) AE confirmé (et donc un expert du produit), et tu es capable de gérer n'importe quel type de lead

  • Tu es owner d'un ou de plusieurs side project.s

  • Tu contribues activement à la mise à jour des process dans notre base interne (Notion)

  • Tu participes au mentoring et à la formation des nouveaux arrivants dans l'équipe

Process de recrutement

- Un premier entretien avec Orane : Senior Business Recruiter (30 min)

- Un deuxième entretien de fit avec Stan, Manager de l’équipe (45 min)

- Une mise en situation + case study avec Stan, Manager de l’équipe et un membre de l'équipe (1h)

  • Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

  • Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes
